name: Mintlify Autopilot
description: Opens pull requests that update your Mintlify docs when merged code changes and runs a daily quality check, for teams that ship docs alongside code. Beta, Pro and Enterprise plans.

skills.name: Code-Change Doc Updates
skills.description: Detects merged code changes in connected repositories and opens pull requests that update the affected documentation.

skills.name: Daily Quality Check
skills.description: Runs a once-daily maintenance check over your documentation and proposes fixes as pull requests for your team to review.

skills.name: Feature Launch Tracking
skills.description: Tracks launches that span several pull requests, opens the docs pull request as a draft, and keeps it current as code merges.

skills.name: Review Comment Follow-up
skills.description: Reads GitHub review comments on its pull requests, pushes the requested changes to the same branch, and replies in the thread.

skills.name: Integration-Triggered Runs
skills.description: Runs when an event happens in a connected integration, such as a new Linear issue or an updated Jira issue.
